svg.title: Closing the MCP client compared with sending tasks/cancel
svg.desc: Left: detaching. The MCP client exits after saving the taskId. The server keeps processing and the task reaches completed; a later tasks/get with the saved ID returns the result. Right: cancelling. The client sends tasks/cancel and receives an empty acknowledgement. The worker checks for cancellation between images, so the current image may finish first. The client reads the real outcome with tasks/get: usually cancelled, or completed if the batch had already finished. Files created before cancellation remain.
